description: List captured HTTP requests with IDs, available status/timing/size fields and pinned or saved markers. Capture depends on supported transports, installed hooks and recording timing; requests made before capture starts may be absent. Use IDs for network actions and flagged to inspect retained records. A flag does not establish who created it or the cause of a problem. Filter by status or URL pattern. includeBodies:true requests available truncated bodies, which can be missing or withheld. Needs the network integration. The list works on the free tier; includeBodies needs Buoy Pro.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

flagged.description: Read KEPT requests instead of the live list: 'pinned' (held at the top of the developer's list), 'saved' (their favorites), 'any' (either). These are separate from the live list; restart retention depends on successful persistence.

includeBodies.description: Include truncated request/response bodies. Default false (compact).

pattern.description: Only requests whose URL contains this substring (case-insensitive).

name: get_network_requests
